g.text: And here we are, twiddling our thumbs. Either you truly have nothing better to do, Usurper, or you have all that you want from me. Which is it?

A new day dawns, and I find myself planning for the future for the first time in... a long time. Thinking on how I could reshape this world around me. On how I could wield what I know. What I am. How I could make better use of it.

A new day dawns, and I find myself planning for the future for the first time in... a long time. Thinking on what this means for me, for what I want, for how I wish to reshape my environment to suit me.
May I ask precisely what it is you are waiting for? I sit here with my recollection of events still perfectly intact. You gave me your word that you would clear them from my mind.
Have you made up your mind yet? I am a patient devil, but I have my limits. Will you wipe my mind clean of these memories, or do you wish to let me linger on?
Here we are, and here we shall remain. In this Purgatory. I hope you enjoy it here, as I do not think we shall ever go a step farther.
A little from column A, a little from column B?
None of this is about you, Roathe. It never has been.
You fool! What have you done?! Why, why go and delve into caverns where you are not welcome?!
I know. But these things take time, and we need to wait.
I changed my mind. I'm sorry.
I will. I'm getting there. I promise.
No. I can't do this. I'm sorry. I can't do this to you.
Fine. I give in. I'll do what you want.
Whatever you seek from me, you shall not have it now. You might as well be done with it and wipe my memory clean of this travesty of ours.
Well, whatever you seek from me, you shall not have it now. You might as well be done with it and wipe my memory clean of this travesty of ours.
That is quite clear, you needn't worry.
I demand you fix this. This is your fault. I can feel it, clawing at me, tearing at me. Like some great beast.
It would be poor form to not acknowledge that this is due to your help, darling. Thank you.
It would be poor form to not acknowledge that this is due to your help, Usurper. Thank you.
It would be poor form to not acknowledge that this is due largely to your help, darling.
It would be poor form to not acknowledge that this is due largely to your help, Usurper.
Mm. Very well. I am a patient devil, but the waters of that well can be exhausted over time, trust me.
I see. As simple as that, is it?
Mm. See that you do. I am a patient devil, but the waters of that well can be exhausted over time, trust me.
Even if it means we are trapped forever in this impasse? You poor, sad Usurper... very well. Purgatory is an improvement over Hell for a devil, is it not?
Good. Get to it. I tire of living with this knowledge in my skull.
Though, what does it matter to you? You have all that you wish to cut from my empty corpse. My ribs are bare and bleached.
Tragic, isn't it? Knowing that the dregs of Entrati's family will never know that the butler moulders down here, wringing his hands in grief? All alone?
It will be the only way forward for you, if that is what you seek. If you care not, then I care not. Do what you will.
Rid me of this. Rid me of this plague. Clear my mind of these memories. I know you can. Use this gift that you have and end it all. Now.
I couldn't leave you chasing that pointy tail of yours forever.
I couldn't leave you chasing that pointy tail of yours forever. It was going to get sad.
Largely? If it weren't for me, you'd still be stuck chasing that pointy tail of yours, Roathe.
Largely? If it weren't for me, you'd still be stuck chasing that pointy tail of yours, Roathe.
I do not know whom the zealots will be more disappointed at; you or I.
And do not concern yourself with bothering the zealots to whine in my ear hoping to convince me to show you mercy. It will not work.
Those are a different kind of memory, Roathe. It won't work on them. They are buried deeper in your psyche.
Running and hiding from the truth won't work. We'll just wind up right back where we started.
Are you sure? But... you're smart, I get the feeling you'll figure something is up.
Do not push your luck, Usurper.
You can also say farewell to our other contract.
I was rather looking forward to watching him shake in terror as he crawled up those stairs in shame.
But what does it matter to you?
That may be. You are very likely right. But I do not have any other options to try, now do I? It is worth the attempt.
And if that is the case, then you can simply do the deed again. It is like you have an inexhaustible gift, isn't it?
Very likely. I will put two and two together and blame you for doing something I did not ask you to do. I am sure you will weather the storm.
Mm, yes, well. I know how much you enjoy this "pointy tail" of mine.
I simply wished to express my gratitude. Not linger on it.
Now that we have that done, I believe we have something else to discuss, do we not?
Mm, yes, well. I know how much you enjoy this "pointy tail" of mine.
You said you'd help if I helped you recovered your memories. And I did. That was our contract!
Wait. Why won't you help me?
I am certain I will be hideously angry at you once I realize you have altered my memories, of course. And I recommend not telling me it was by my request, darling.
Well, whatever you seek from me, you shall not have it now. You might as well be done with it and wipe my memory clean of this travesty of ours.
Don't be so bitter, just because you realize now that you have been outplayed. I offered you the terms of the contract without ever spelling out my end of things. Or did you fail to notice?
I offered you the terms of the contract without ever spelling out my end of things. Or did you fail to notice?
"I am in need of someone to help me record my memories and assist me in reconciling them. A temporary assistant of sorts."
I will simply claim you are lying, and it will likely damage my opinion of you beyond repair.
Each time we speak I cannot help but wonder if the shores we tread are familiar or foreign to you. If I am merely repeating myself, or if I hold some new surprise.
You upheld your end of our contract. We have now come to the penultimate point where we must arrange the particulars of how we will lay out our method of attack.
It will be the only way forward for you, if that is what you seek. If you care not, then I care not. Do what you will.
I simply said what you would have out of the arrangement. I never said what you had to do, or why, to get them. And you blindly agreed.
While you met the first criteria, "recording my memories," you failed spectacularly at the latter, "assist me in reconciling them."
No. I can't do this. I won't do this. We have to face down this situation together. Can't we just talk about this?
I... there's really no other way?
Either way, I rather you not tell me. I hate when I am too overtly predictable. Regardless, you have helped me resolve a matter keenly important to my own self.
This battle must be waged on three fronts. All must work in concert for this war to be won.
Well, whatever you seek from me, you shall not have it now. You might as well be done with it and wipe my memory clean of this travesty of ours, "Drifter darling."
And do not concern yourself with bothering the zealots to whine in my ear hoping to convince me to show you mercy. It will not work.
This is what is called a "blank cheque" in olden terms I believe? And you signed it quite willingly.
I would hardly say they are reconciled, would you?
No. If you want the butler to go upstairs? You wipe my mind of all of this nonsense as I have asked. If you do not care? Then do as you wish. It matters not to me.
I slept better last night than I have in so very long. I would say "longer than I can remember," but that would be a joke in very poor taste.
It will be the only way forward for you, if that is what you seek. If you care not, then I care not. Do what you will.
Is there any way I could change your mind?
How do I get out of this?
You did not meet your end of the bargain, so I shall not meet mine.
That, and, well, of course, our personal friendship is the only leverage I own in this situation. It is that simple.
So in turn, I shall now help you. The butler. Do you wish to still reunite him with Albrecht's family upstairs?
The butler. Reuniting him with Albrecht's family. You still wish to do this, yes?
Yes. Do try to keep up. I assume you still wish to reunite him Albrecht's family upstairs, yes?
And do not concern yourself with bothering the zealots to whine in my ear hoping to convince me to show you mercy. It will not work.
No. And I am no longer in the mood to assist you in such matters.
The same way you found yourself mired in it in the first place.
Is there any way I could change your mind?
How do I get out of this?
Or perhaps a new methodology is required. I am not here to assist you in such matters.
No. And I am no longer in the mood to assist you in such matters.
I think you know how. But in case you've forgotten, allow me to remind you... what is the phrase?
Okay. I'll... I'll do it. I'll wipe your mind. Even if it'll take Marie and Lyon's with it.
No. I refuse. I'll find another way to convince you to move forward.
No, it's fine. It's not that important to me.
Sadly, neither Marie or Lyon are going to be on board.
I'm not sure if Marie is going to be on board.
I'm not sure if Lyon is going to be on board.
I don't believe either Marie or Lyon are going to be on board.
No, it's fine. It's not that important to me.
I'm not sure if Marie is going to be on board.
I'm not sure if Lyon is going to be on board.
I wish you the best of luck.
You do all this work, you come all this way, and now you decide it...
How in the name of the Void did you manage to bungle it with the both of them?!
How in the name of the Void did you manage to bungle it with the both of them?!
You do all this work, you come all this way, and now you decide it...
You are confounding. Utterly and maddeningly perplexing.
Most excellent. You will have my support when it is needed. But this will take time. The butler is a stubborn fool, and it will take a coordinated attack.
Most excellent. You will have my support when it is needed, but be warned. We will need both of the zealots to work in concert with my efforts to get convince the butler to walk up those stairs.
Most excellent. You will have my support when it is needed, but be warned. We will need both of the zealots to work in concert with my efforts to get convince the butler to walk up those stairs.
Most excellent. You will have my support when it is needed, but be warned. We will need both of the zealots to work in concert with my efforts to get convince the butler to walk up those stairs.
Very well. I will do what I can to clean up this mess for you. But understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.
You are confounding. Utterly and maddeningly perplexing.
Most excellent. You will have my support when it is needed. But this will take time. The butler is a stubborn fool, and it will take a coordinated attack.
Most excellent. You will have my support when it is needed, but be warned. We will need both of the zealots to work in concert with my efforts to get convince the butler to walk up those stairs.
Most excellent. You will have my support when it is needed, but be warned. We will need both of the zealots to work in concert with my efforts to get convince the butler to walk up those stairs.
Most excellent. You will have my support when it is needed, but be warned. We will need both of the zealots to work in concert with my efforts to get convince the butler to walk up those stairs.
I have nothing left to do but throw up my hands and walk away, lest I pull out my hair in frustration.
Very well. And do not think I have forgotten our arrangement. I promised you that I would clean up this mess for you, and I shall. As you predicted, you needed it.
Very well. I will do what I can to clean up this mess for you. But understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.
Well done securing the support of the zealots. Marie and Lyon will be invaluable, as much as I am loathe to admit it.
He is a stubborn fool, and it will take a coordinated attack. I recommend treading with caution and doing all you can to ensure you have the support of both zealots when the time comes.
He is a stubborn fool, and it will take a coordinated attack. I recommend treading with caution and doing all you can to ensure you have the support of both zealots when the time comes.
He is a stubborn fool, and it will take a coordinated attack. I recommend treading with caution and doing all you can to ensure you have the support of both zealots when the time comes.
I have nothing left to do but throw up my hands and walk away, lest I pull out my hair in frustration.
Well done securing the support of the zealots. Marie and Lyon will be invaluable, as much as I am loathe to admit it.
He is a stubborn fool, and it will take a coordinated attack. I recommend treading with caution and doing all you can to ensure you have the support of both zealots when the time comes.
He is a stubborn fool, and it will take a coordinated attack. I recommend treading with caution and doing all you can to ensure you have the support of both zealots when the time comes.
He is a stubborn fool, and it will take a coordinated attack. I recommend treading with caution and doing all you can to ensure you have the support of both zealots when the time comes.
I shall clear the way and ensure that all shall fall neatly into place. Expect conversations with the zealots in the next few days. Ah. And remember?
In the meanwhile, I council patience. We will speak again on the topic when it is time.
You may have the support of Marie already, and while Lyon is therefore likely to follow suit, be careful. And furthermore, this will take time.
You may have the support of Lyon already, but Marie will require more careful navigation, I fear. And furthermore, this will take time.
In the meanwhile, I council patience. We will speak again on the topic when it is time.
You may have the support of Marie already, and while Lyon is therefore likely to follow suit, be careful. And furthermore, this will take time.
You may have the support of Lyon already, but Marie will require more careful navigation, I fear. And furthermore, this will take time.
You owe the devil a debt.
I council patience. We will speak again on the topic when it is time. So in the meanwhile?
I council patience. We will speak again on the topic when it is time. So in the meanwhile?
I council patience. We will speak again on the topic when it is time. So in the meanwhile?

I council patience. We will speak again on the topic when it is time. So in the meanwhile?
I council patience. We will speak again on the topic when it is time. So in the meanwhile?
Do your best not to bungle it up with Lyon. Though I suppose if you do, we all know how you will solve it, don't we?
Do your best not to bungle it up with Marie. Though I suppose if you do, we all know how you will solve it, don't we?
Do your best not to bungle it up with the other two. Though I suppose if you do, we all know how you will solve it, don't we?
Do your best not to bungle it up with Lyon, yes?
Do your best not to bungle it up with Marie, yes?
Do your best not to bungle it up with the other two, yes?
